info.title: Koan
info.description: Command-line interface for Koan orchestration: discover modules, render Compose bundles, and execute provider workflows.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check provider availability and tooling health.

commands.name: down
commands.description: Stop the project stack and optionally prune volumes.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Render orchestration assets for the current project.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Detect project context, dependencies, and provider readiness.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Tail orchestrated service logs via the active provider.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show provider status, live endpoints, and plan hints.

commands.name: up
commands.description: Generate and start the project stack locally.
